sound_intent.description: Emotional vibe with sparse verses and impactful, strong hooks using diverse sample chop techniques.

routing_intent.description: Separate routing of chop techniques into dedicated channels named after chopping methods for clarity and mixing control.

track_roles.drums: rhythm backbone with emphasis on boom bap groove
track_roles.vocal: vocal chops and stutter effects as lead elements

designer_intent.note: Focus on mainstream boom bap with emotional resonance and clear distinction between verses and hooks.

presetor_intent.note: Presets should favor classic boom bap tones with modern clean mastering for vocal chops.

sensei_drum.brief: Create rhythmic drum patterns that maintain boom bap groove with sparse fills during verses and full energy during hooks.

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines that are supportive and emotive, locking tightly with drums but remaining subdued in verses.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce chord progressions that add warmth and emotional depth without overpowering the sparse verse structure.

melody_generator.brief: Design minimal melody motifs that complement vocal chops and maintain emotional tone without crowding arrangement.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement flow ensuring energy builds naturally from sparse verses to strong hooks using sample chop variations.

presetor.brief: Apply presets matching classic boom bap sound: warm, vintage but clean, especially optimizing vocal chop clarity.

songgps.brief: Manage energy curve and section transitions reflecting sparse verses and energetic hooks with proper event markers.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Perform initial mixing balancing sample layers and keeping dynamics clear, especially separating chop channels and vocal elements.
